verdict.rationale: Stripe's Disputes API lets you programmatically upload evidence, respond to disputes, and receive dispute webhook events. Its official agent tooling covers the rest of the loop: the hosted MCP server's generic stripe_api_read (any GET method) handles retrieval, and its documented supported-method list includes dispute updates, so an agent can submit the response. Restricted keys and OAuth scope that agent access. Missing for 10: no documented way to upload evidence files through the MCP/agent tools, no dispute-specific agent skill or end-to-end agent walkthrough, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing a dispute.
